name: Walking
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 17190: walking 2.8-3.4 mph, level, moderate pace, firm surface = MET 3.8. Default casual-walk value.

name: Brisk Walking
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 17200: walking 3.5-3.9 mph, level, brisk, walking for exercise = MET 4.8. (Very brisk 4.0-4.4 mph is 17220 = 5.5.) 4.8 separates brisk/fast/power from ex_walk.

name: Jogging
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 12020: jogging, general, self-selected pace = MET 7.5. Ambulatory (jog collides with steps on same day).

name: Running
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 12050: running 6-6.3 mph (10 min/mile) = MET 9.3. Default recreational-run value (slower 5 mph is 12030 = 8.5). Ambulatory.

name: Treadmill
notes: Treadmill has no single Compendium code; value depends on walk vs run and incline. MET 6.0 as a mid blend (between brisk walk 4.8 and jog 7.5). Ambulatory per spec/06 double-count rule (treadmill listed alongside walk/jog/run/hike).

name: Hiking
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 17080: hiking, cross country = MET 6.0. Ambulatory.

name: Cycling
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 01014: bicycling, general = MET 7.0. (Light 10-11.9 mph is 01020 = 6.8; moderate 12-13.9 mph is 01030 = 8.0.) Not ambulatory. Spin/spinning folded in for simplicity. Minutes for effort logging; distance-based '10 km cycling' parses as this id with unit km (see compose.ts per-exercise km pace).

name: Swimming
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 18310: swimming, leisurely, not lap swimming, general = MET 6.0. Matches undifferentiated 'swimming' better than laps (18240 slow recreational = 5.8, 18230 fast vigorous = 9.8).

name: Yoga
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 02185: yoga, Vinyasa = MET 2.7 (Hatha 02150 = 2.3, Power 02160 = 4.0). Vinyasa ~ a typical flow class, the default for undifferentiated 'yoga'.

name: Surya Namaskar
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium: 'Yoga, Surya Namaskar' has a measured MET of 2.7 — a measured value replaces the earlier 4.0 estimate. FLAG(nirmal): users often log by rounds ('12 surya namaskar'); one round ~1 min, so qty is treated as minutes pending a rounds->minutes spec decision.

name: Gym / Weight Training
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium: general multi-exercise session (02054, 8-15 reps varied resistance) = MET 3.5; vigorous power/body-building (02050) = 6.0. 4.0 is a conservative-leaning blend for a catch-all 'gym'/'workout' — deliberately guards against over-crediting movement into the food budget (MASTER.md exercise-as-allowance caution). Not ambulatory.

name: Badminton
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 15030: badminton, social singles and doubles, general = MET 5.5. Not ambulatory.

name: Cricket
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 15150: cricket, batting, bowling, fielding = MET 4.8. (Prior draft cited 15040, which is basketball in the 2024 numbering — corrected.) Not ambulatory (much standing between deliveries).

name: Football
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 15610: soccer, casual, general = MET 7.0. Casual default. Left NOT ambulatory per spec/06, which defines ambulatory narrowly (walk/jog/run/hike/treadmill only) — football's running does not stack against step count.

name: Skipping Rope
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 15551: rope jumping, moderate pace, general, 100-120 skips/min = MET 11.8 (slow 15552 = 8.3). Moderate default. Not ambulatory (vertical, not step-tracked).

name: Dancing
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium: general moderate dancing = MET 5.0 (ethnic/cultural 03025 = 4.5; vigorous folk/nightclub 03031 = 9.8). 5.0 general default. Known undercount: high-energy garba/bhangra runs vigorous-folk (7-9.8); a dedicated regional-dance id can be split later if reviews ask. Not ambulatory.

name: Stairs Climbing
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium: stair climbing slow (17133) = 4.5, fast one-step-at-a-time (17134) = 9.3. 8.0 for deliberate stair-climbing exercise (between the two). Only for intentional exercise logging, not everyday stair use. Not ambulatory (stair-machine climbing is not step-count double-counted).

name: Elliptical Trainer
notes: 2024 Adult Compendium 02048: elliptical trainer, moderate effort = MET 5.0. Not ambulatory (spec/06 excludes it from the walk/jog/run/hike/treadmill set).

name: Zumba
notes: No dedicated Zumba code; 2024 Adult Compendium aerobic dance runs 4.8 (low impact) to 8.0 (high impact). 6.5 sits mid and matches ACE Zumba studies. Not ambulatory.

name: Pilates
notes: Pilates has no stable dedicated Compendium code across editions (the 2024 renumbering reassigned 02101); general mat Pilates is widely cited at MET ~3.0. Kept 3.0 as the general default; reformer/advanced trends higher. Not ambulatory.
